claims.source_name: Franco-Nevada 2023 Annual Report; Royal Gold 2023 Annual Report; Wheaton Precious Metals 2023 Annual Report
claims.notes: Streaming companies hold contractual rights to purchase fixed percentages of mine output at below-market fixed prices. Top 3 streaming companies collectively entitled to ~5% of global mine production (~175 tonnes/year). Abstract claim value estimated as NPV of streaming obligations at current spot. Coupling is high (~0.90) because streaming rights are legally tied to actual physical production — decoupling is value-capture (phi concern) not physical abstraction (e concern). Rehypothecation not applicable.

Net smelter return (NSR) and gross overriding royalties entitle holders to a percentage of revenue from mine output. Coupling ratio near 1.0 — royalties only trigger if physical gold is actually produced and sold. No physical decoupling. E-layer fully coherent at this sub-layer.

claims.source_name: World Gold Council Gold Demand Trends 2023; company annual reports
claims.notes: Producer hedging (forward sales) has declined dramatically from >3000 tonnes in early 2000s to ~100 tonnes currently. Each forward sale commits specific anticipated future production. Coupling ratio = 1.0 — the abstract forward claim is directly tied to and cancelled by physical delivery. Not rehypothecated.

claims.source_name: World Gold Council Gold Demand Trends 2023; BIS OTC Derivatives Statistics; IMF Article IV consultations; Jeffrey Christian (CPM Group) CFTC Hearing testimony March 2010
claims.notes: Gold on lease globally estimated at 5000-8000 tonnes (WGC/analyst consensus). Midpoint 6500 tonnes used. Physical gold has physically moved from central bank vaults to bullion bank/refinery working capital. Central bank records it as still held. Bullion bank uses it as working capital and may re-lend to a second institution. Same physical gold underpins 2-3 simultaneous claims. Coupling ratio estimated 0.40 (gold lent 2-3 times on average). This is the most significant structural rehypothecation mechanism in the upstream chain. Source for re-lending rate: CPM Group; Gold Anti-Trust Action Comm

claims.source_name: LBMA documentation; Bank for International Settlements OTC derivatives statistics
claims.notes: Loco swaps are location-exchange agreements: gold physically in London is swapped with gold physically in New York or Zurich. Each leg has a corresponding physical asset. Coupling ratio near 1.0. Not rehypothecated. Minor slippage from settlement timing gives ~0.95.

claims.source_name: LBMA Allocated Account documentation; custodian prospectus filings
claims.notes: Allocated gold: specific serial-numbered bars are legally assigned to account holder. Custodian cannot use the gold for any other purpose. Full 1:1 physical backing by definition. E-layer perfectly coupled at this sub-layer.

claims.source_name: LBMA Unallocated Account documentation (publicly describes allocated vs unallocated distinction); Jeffrey Christian (CPM Group) CFTC Hearing March 2010 (estimated 100:1 paper to physical in bullion banking at that time); BIS OTC derivatives statistics
claims.notes: THIS IS THE PRIMARY E-LAYER OPACITY. Unallocated LBMA positions are not publicly reported in aggregate. No regulator collects or publishes this figure. Analyst estimates of the coupling ratio range from 0.01 to 0.10. E-score of 5 uses midpoint of this range (0.05) and is flagged ESTIMATED/OPAQUE. The actual figure may be lower. This is the most significant decoupling event in the entire gold supply chain and the defining structural feature of the paper gold market. Jeffrey Christian (2010) described the bullion banking system as operating with ~100 units of paper claims per 1 unit of physical

claims.source_name: World Gold Council ETF tracker (monthly); GLD prospectus SEC filing; IAU prospectus SEC filing; independent auditor reports (annual physical audit)
claims.notes: ETF gold is held in allocated, audited, segregated accounts. Annual independent physical audits are required. Coupling ratio ~0.98 reflects minor tracking differences from management fees and creation/redemption timing. Not rehypothecated. The strongest e-layer coherence in the downstream vaulting layer. Total global gold ETF holdings ~80-100M oz as of 2024 (WGC tracker). Midpoint 90M oz used.

claims.source_name: COMEX daily warehouse reports (public, free); CFTC Commitment of Traders report (public, weekly); CME Group contract specifications
claims.notes: COMEX registered inventory (physically deliverable) ~5-8M oz as of 2024 (midpoint 6M oz used). Total open interest ~400000-500000 contracts x 100 oz = 40-50M oz equivalent (midpoint 45M oz used). Coupling ratio = 6/45 = 0.133. This means only ~13% of open interest is backed by deliverable physical gold at any given time. The overwhelming majority of contracts are cash-settled or rolled without physical delivery — this is by design and fully disclosed in COMEX contract specifications. E-score = 13. claims.source_name: Acorn EP Carbon Season 1–3 project documentation; Gold Standard VCU registry; RONGEAD 2019 Shea Value Chain Report
claims.notes: Shea parkland carbon credits are issued against verified CO2 sequestration by shea trees. Physical backing: ~2.7M tCO2e verified in Acorn S1-S3. Abstract issued: 4.2M tCO2e (Acorn alone). Coupling risk: additionality concerns (shea trees were there before the project), permanence risk (climate stress, land clearing), leakage. Coupling estimated at 0.65 reflecting ~35% discount for permanence and additionality uncertainty. Not rehypothecated but same credit may be counted in multiple corporate Scope 3 registries.

claims.source_name: RONGEAD 2019 Shea Value Chain Analysis; KPMG 2018 Sector Review; Fairtrade International annual reports; Rainforest Alliance sourcing reports
claims.notes: PRIMARY DECOUPLING. Research consistently shows only 10–30% of Fair Trade certified shea volumes actually receives the farmgate premium. Estimated: ~120,000t certified globally; ~15,000t receives documented premium. Brand buyers report 100% of volume in sustainability disclosures as 'Fair Trade certified'. Collectors receive standard market price for remainder. Abstract certification claims vastly exceed verified premium delivery. Not financial rehypothecation — structural certification gap.

claims.source_name: ECOCERT Africa certification registry; processor annual reports; Export Promotion Authority Ghana
claims.notes: Organic certification requires physical field inspection and chain-of-custody documentation. Coupling is relatively high (0.78) compared to Fair Trade because third-party auditors conduct real site visits. Gap reflects: some double-counting with Fair Trade certification; minor yield estimation errors; small volumes included without full traceability back to specific farms. Most reliable certification layer in the shea chain.

claims.source_name: IFC commodity finance documentation; Standard Chartered trade finance reports; Ghana Export Promotion Authority statistics
claims.notes: Letters of credit are backed by bills of lading and warehouse receipts. High coupling — financial instrument is cancelled by physical delivery. Standard documentary trade finance structure. Minor 0.05 slippage from renegotiated terms, partial shipments, and credit note adjustments. Not rehypothecated.

claims.source_name: Commodity trade desk filings; AAK annual report; IOI Group sourcing disclosures; UNCTAD commodity finance review 2022
claims.notes: Larger buyers lock in supply price via bilateral OTC forward contracts. No central clearing or exchange registration. Coupling below 1.0 due to: contract re-negotiation when market moves sharply (common in soft commodity markets), partial delivery acceptance, and some speculative positioning by commodity traders. Volume estimate from UNCTAD and buyer disclosure analysis.

claims.source_name: L'Oréal Sustainability Report 2023; Unilever Sustainable Living Plan 2022; BASF Beauty Ingredients sourcing policy; Global Shea Alliance membership disclosures
claims.notes: SECOND MAJOR DECOUPLING POINT. Companies market approximately $1.9B worth of 'sustainable shea' cosmetics and food products annually. Traceability typically extends only to tier-1 aggregator — not to specific cooperatives or collectors. Physical backing is the proportion of volume with verified chain-of-custody documentation back to farm level (estimated $800M, sourced via verified GSA-compliant schemes). Coupling 0.42 reflects the structural gap between brand-level sustainability claims and farm-level verification. This is an authenticity coupling problem rather than a financial coupling prob
